shared: Bright, true-to-life cookbook photograph. Camera at about 40 degrees, 50mm lens, the whole dish in sharp focus. Soft, even daylight from the upper left, with one short soft shadow to the lower right. Background: a smooth, matte, seamless surface and wall in the backdrop colour given for the image, one flat colour edge to edge, evenly lit, with no vignette, no gradient, no darker corners and no horizon line. No props: only the dish on the backdrop. Keep any accent colour to slate blue (#486B7B) or apricot (#F59443), used on one small thing only. Framing: the dish sits dead centre, left to right and top to bottom, and is about half the frame width, so a tall, narrow crop of the middle half still shows all of it. A tall glass uses height instead, about three quarters of the frame height. Landscape 3:2, 1536 x 1024. Style reference: match the attached reference image for light, white balance, camera height, scale and how flat the backdrop is; change only the dish and the backdrop colour, and leave out its props. Fresh, lively and appetizing, natural colour, bright and airy. Avoid: steam, smoke or vapour of any kind, text, logos, hands, people, dark or moody light, wooden tables, marble, patterned surfaces, props, cutlery, napkins, garnishes not listed for the dish, cartoon or illustration style, plastic-looking food, exaggerated saturation.

images.chicken-pho.png: Dish: Phở Gà (Vietnamese chicken noodle soup). The dish: a large bowl of clear, light golden chicken broth you can see into, with flat, wide, translucent white rice noodles (bánh phở) folded in ribbons beneath slices of tender poached chicken, topped with fresh herbs. Show the clear golden broth, flat ribbon-like rice noodles and sliced poached chicken. Texture: a crystal-clear, see-through broth with a few small shiny droplets on the surface; the noodles are flat and slippery like wide ribbons, not round, thick or curly. Colours: clear gold broth, white noodles, pale chicken, bright green herbs. Serving dish: a large wide white soup bowl with a thin slate blue rim. Garnish, and nothing else on the food: thinly sliced scallions, chopped cilantro and a few Thai basil leaves. Setting: Vietnamese home cooking. Backdrop: soft peach (#FFB07E). Moment: just ladled, the broth clear and glistening.
images.healthy-banana-bread.png: Dish: Banana Bread. The dish: one thick, neat slice of banana bread standing upright on its edge, its cut face turned to the camera, in front of the cut end of the loaf; the slice shows a moist, tender crumb speckled with dark chocolate chips and a deep golden-brown crust. Show the clean cut face of the slice with its moist, speckled crumb, and the domed, cracked golden top of the loaf behind. Texture: a moist, tender, even crumb with straight, clean cut edges and a lightly crisp crust. Colours: warm golden brown, a darker crust and dark chocolate flecks. Serving dish: a small white rectangular plate with a thin slate blue rim. No garnish. Setting: an everyday breakfast or snack at home. Backdrop: soft peach (#FFB07E). Moment: freshly sliced.
